services.desc: This spacious pontoon boat is great for large groups or families and can accommodate up to 12 people. Outfitted with plush furnishings and a full-length sun deck, it's perfect for relaxing afternoons. It comes with wide surfaces, plenty of cupholders, an onboard toilet, and all the amenities you need to make your day on the water a memorable one. Whether you're looking for a casual cruise, a party float, or a weekend getaway - the 26' Bennington Pontoon Boat rises to the occasion. So bring your cooler and hit the waves - it's time to enjoy life on the Chesapeake Bay! The South River is a tributary of the Chesapeake Bay located in Anne Arundel County, Maryland, USA.
